Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"def alpha():
    pass

def beta():
    pass

def gamma():
    pass

def delta():
    pass
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"chunk_max_size":30,"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.metrics.total_lines);
    println!("{:?}", result.chunks);
}
```
